clauses.title: Manner in which complaint to be made
clauses.text: (i) after the order of the insurer 1 [or insurance broker, as the case may be,] rejecting the representation is received; or (ii) after receipt of decision of the insurer 1 [or insurance broker, as the case may be], which is not to the satisfaction of the complainant; (iii) after expiry of a period of one month from the date of sending the written representation to the insurer 1 [or insurance broker, as the case may be, ] if the insurer or 1 [ insurance broker, as the case may be ], named fails to furnish reply to the complainant. (4) The Ombudsman shall be empowered to condone the delay in such cases as he may consider necessary, after calling for objections of the insurer or insurance broker , as the case may be, against the proposed condonation and after recording reasons for condoning the delay and in case the delay is condoned, the date of condonation of delay shall be deemed to be the date of filing of the complaint, for further proceedings under these rules. (5) No complaint before the Insurance Ombudsman shall be maintainable on the same subject matter on which proceedings are pending before or disposed of by any court or consumer forum or arbitrator. 1[(6) The Council for Insurance Ombudsmen shall develop a complaints management system, which shall include an online platform developed for the purpose of online submission and tracking of the status of complaints made under rule 14]. ___________ 1 Substituted by notification G.S.R. 147 (E), dated 2.3.2021
clauses.query: complaint to insurer representation rejected or no reply within one month

clauses.title: Manner in which complaint to be made
clauses.text: 14. Manner in which complaint to be made.—(1) Any person who has a grievance against an insurer 1 [or insurance broker] may himself or through his legal heirs, nominee or assignee, make a complaint in writing to the Insurance Ombudsman within whose territorial jurisdiction the branch or office of the insurer 1 [or the insurance broker, as the case may be,] complained against or the residential address or place of residence of the complainant is located. (2) The complaint shall be in writing, duly 1 [signed, or made by way of electronic mail or online through the website of the Council for Insurance Ombudsmen,] by the complainant or through his legal heirs, nominee or assignee and shall state clearly the name and address of the complainant, the name of the branch or office of the insurer against whom the complaint is made, the facts giving rise to the co mplaint, supported by documents, the nature and extent of the loss caused to the complainant and the relief sought from the Insurance Ombudsman. (3) No complaint to the Insurance Ombudsman shall lie unless (a) the complainant 1 [has made a representation in writing or through electronic mail or online through website of the insurer or insurance broker concerned] named in the complaint and— (i) either the insurer 1 [or insurance broker, as the case may be,] had rejected the complaint; or (ii) the complainant had not received any reply within a period of one month after the insurer 1 [or insurance broker, as the case may be,] received his representation; or (iii) the complainant is not satisfied with the reply given to him by the insurer 1 [or insurance broker, as the case may be.] (b) The complaint is made within one year—
clauses.query: complaint to insurer representation rejected or no reply within one month

clauses.title: Award
clauses.text: 17. Award.—(1) Where the complaint is not settled by way of mediation under rule 16, the Ombudsman shall pass an award, based on the pleadings and evidence brought on record. 2 [(2) The award passed under the sub -rule (1) shall be in writing, duly signed in person or digitally by the Insurance Ombudsman with reasons for passing such award.] (3)Where the award is in favour of the complainant, it shall state the amount of compensation granted to the complainant after deducting the amount already paid, if any, from the award: ________________ 1 Substituted by notification G.S.R. 147 (E), dated 2.3.2021 2. Substituted by notification G.S.R. 828 (E), dated 9.11.2023 Provided that the Ombudsman shall,— (i) not award any compensation in excess of the loss suffered by the complainant as a direct consequence of the cause of action; or (ii) not award compensation exceeding rupees 3 [fifty] lakhs (including relevant expenses, if any). (4) The Ombudsman shall finalise its findings and pass an award within a period of three months of the receipt of all requirements from the complainant. (5) A copy of the award shall be sent to the complainant and the insurer 1 [or insurance broker, as the case may be,] named in the complaint. final.markdown:
# Formal Grievance: Rejection of Health Insurance Claim - [POLICY / CLAIM NUMBER]

**To:** Insurer's Grievance Redressal Officer <support@starhealth.in>

स्टार हेल्थ द्वारा आपके 85,000 रुपये के स्वास्थ्य बीमा दावे को खारिज करने के खिलाफ यह एक औपचारिक शिकायत है। हमने कंपनी से दावे की समीक्षा करने या अस्वीकृति का स्पष्ट कारण बताने का अनुरोध किया है। यदि 15 दिनों के भीतर समाधान नहीं मिलता है, तो आप IRDAI बीमा भरोसा पोर्टल पर शिकायत दर्ज कर सकते हैं।

```
To,
Insurer's Grievance Redressal Officer
Star Health
Email: support@starhealth.in

Date: 09 October 2026

Subject: Formal Grievance: Rejection of Health Insurance Claim - [POLICY / CLAIM NUMBER]

Dear Sir/Madam,

I am writing to formally contest the rejection of my health insurance claim amounting to 85,000 rupees under [POLICY / CLAIM NUMBER]. I request a comprehensive review of my claim file and the specific grounds for this rejection. As a policyholder, I am entitled to a clear and transparent explanation regarding the denial of benefits. Please provide a detailed justification for this decision or process the approval of the claim amount immediately. I expect a formal response to this grievance within 15 days. Should this matter remain unresolved or if the response is unsatisfactory, I will escalate this complaint to the IRDAI Bima Bharosa portal for further intervention as per the regulatory framework.

Yours faithfully,
[YOUR NAME]
[PHONE]
[EMAIL]
[ADDRESS]
```

## If there's no reply
1. **Insurer's Grievance Redressal Officer** (email / grievance portal — support@starhealth.in) — First. Quote policy and claim numbers.
2. **IRDAI Bima Bharosa** (portal / email / phone) — Unresolved or unsatisfactory: register on Bima Bharosa (complaints@irdai.gov.in). https://bimabharosa.irdai.gov.in · 155255 / 1800 4254 732
3. **Insurance Ombudsman** (Council for Insurance Ombudsmen) — Insurer rejected your complaint or did not reply within one month: complain within one year (awards up to ₹50 lakh). https://www.cioins.co.in

_Information, not legal advice._
